name_overlay.title: What name should we use for your certificate?
name_overlay.sub: Enter your name exactly as you would like it to appear.
intro.heading: Congratulations!
cert.blurb: This certificate confirms the completion of the Global IQ Test. The IQ score presented represents a measurement of cognitive performance based on your answers to the test.
share.heading: Share your result
share.sub: Let people know how you did.
note.text: About your score. GlobalIQ is designed for educational and entertainment purposes. It is not a clinical assessment, it is not administered by a licensed psychologist, and it should not be used for employment, academic placement, or medical decisions. Results vary with tiredness, environment, and familiarity with the question format.
next.heading: What next
next.item1: A copy of this certificate has been sent to your email address.
next.item2: Questions about your result or your subscription? Visit the Help Center.
next.item3: Need to stop future charges? Use the Cancellation Portal.
